name: sensor-anxiety-detection-sample
title: Sensor: physiological and questionnaire sample
description: Six CSV resources from one participant: raw sensor and questionnaire observations for Session 1, plus supplied eye summaries for three sessions. The analysis is descriptive; recording devices, calibration and cross-stream clock synchronization are not established by these files. See data/DATA_DICTIONARY.md, DATA_ETHICS.md and NOTICE.md.

fields.description: Dimensionless Euclidean displacement between consecutive gaze-direction vectors; null on the first row. Not angular velocity.

fields.name: fixation
fields.description: Legacy low-movement flag: gaze_diff <0.01, first sample false. Unvalidated; false is not a measured saccade label.

fields.name: fixation_id
fields.description: 1-based counter over every contiguous true or false legacy flag run; includes non-fixation runs.

fields.name: duration
fields.description: Last-minus-first reltime span in seconds for a true legacy run, repeated on its rows; null for false runs. No minimum-duration rule.

resources.description: Legacy low-movement segmentation of sed.csv using consecutive gaze-vector displacement <0.01; unvalidated, with no quality, gap or minimum-duration rule.
